task_instruction: Go through my portfolio from an income perspective - check each holding's current price and browse any relevant news. Email an income analysis summarizing the portfolio's yield characteristics to iris.chen@dragonwell.com. Include the 52-week high and low for each holding, and note each stock's trailing EPS (especially if negative).
